correctness.rationale: The strong-matching face rule is exact for a one-dimensional graph: one earlier neighbor gives precisely one incidence pair. Both standalone implementations enumerate all 720 permutations and agree on 96 total faces, f=(20,55,20). The supplied 20-pair collapse certificate is checked against every remaining face and leaves a connected (20-vertex,35-edge) graph, proving a wedge of 16 circles integrally and by simple homotopy. Signed Lefschetz traces on all D5 elements are (16,1,-4) on H1; character comparison proves 4 sign modules plus 3 rational standard modules. Boundary-rank checks independently confirm mod-two ranks. No infinite-size wheel claim is inferred.

value.rationale: The first six-vertex odd wheel \(K_1*C_5\) is a canonical cone-over-cycle test case for the newly introduced full strong Morse complex, connecting the paper’s cycle and star examples without being covered by either. The explicit collapse identifies all integral homotopy groups and free fundamental rank, and the complete D5 character shows the striking disappearance of invariant cycles despite sixteen integral circles. Both exact invariants furnish natural benchmarks and a nontrivial contrast to ordinary wheel Morse complexes; the result does not depend on arbitrary labels or a tiny numerical improvement.
